mechanism: Lock one treatment surface and orientation, apply distinct tools or materials where each step changes the state needed by the next, accumulate a readable covering layer, perform one late removal or rinse, then use a separate inspection action to verify the stable finished surface.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable treatment surface and baseline before application.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting mid-process hides the initial condition.

invariants.rule: Give each tool or material a distinct visible duty.
invariants.purpose: Turns montage into a causal procedure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random tools provide no process logic.

invariants.rule: Keep intermediate layers relevant to the next step.
Use one late covering-layer removal as the decisive reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several repeated peels weaken the event.

invariants.rule: Verify the finished surface with a separate inspection action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending during removal leaves completion untested.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's face and beauty identity
skincare cream, serum and cosmetic device
mirror, mist and source treatment order
